name: DBpedia Videogames Subset (65k Videogames)
description: Subset of the DBpedia knowledge base describing approximately 65,000 videogames. For each videogame, the dataset includes information about the release date, the platform, the developer, the genre, and the series the game belongs to. The DBpedia knowledge base been automatically extracted from Wikipedia. The dataset has been created by query the DBpedia SPARQL endpoint.

variableMeasured.name: wiki_ref
variableMeasured.description: DBpedia-derived record identifier for the videogame

variableMeasured.name: title
variableMeasured.description: Official or common title of the videogame

variableMeasured.name: launch_yr
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: studio
variableMeasured.description: Developer or studio associated with the videogame

variableMeasured.name: system
variableMeasured.description: Platform or system on which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: franchise
variableMeasured.description: Series or franchise the videogame belongs to
